senses.gloss: गाढ a. (f. ढा) 1. Dived into, bathed in, deeply entered; 2. closely pressed together, tightly drawn, close, fast, R.xvi.60, Am.S.36; 3. thick, dense; 4. full of, thickly inhabited by, तपस्विगाढां तमसां प्राप नदीं तुरंगमेण R.ix.72; 5. strong, vehement, प्राप्तगाढप्रकंपा Sr.T.12, Am.S.72; 6. much, excessive, गाढोत्कंटां गुरुषु दिवसेष्वेषु गच्छत्सु बालाम् Megh.ii.20.(गाढम् is used a an indeclinable in the sense of ‘closely, fast, excessively, much, heavily &c.’)
